Skill arm rerun on q06, q07, q09, 2 runs each, in fresh scratch folders via deploy.sh; no-skill outputs reused from the previous run (unchanged inputs). Blind judge per case. Agent-tool subagents, not the CLI harness; codex and grok not run.
